description:
Make each built-in validation gate checker compute the one report over its captured image and report the selection the plan's `checker-selections` contract assigns it, deleting the checkers' private pipelines.

## Background

- Dispatch: `execute_builtin_checker_with_repository_view` (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1052-1200`). The repository checker calls `validate_repository_report` (`:1083-1086`), the whole capture that also reads every gate run and the whole event log for record fidelity; it is one of the two history readers f8a6b298 names under its DEC-19. The issue checker calls `captured_issue_rule_report` (`:423-485`), the label-target checker `label_target_report` (`:643-674`) and then `captured_scope_rule_report` (`:487-564`), and both call `repository_rule_report` (`:413-421`), a full repository validation, only to keep its dangling-link and drift findings. The rule checker calls `rule_validation_outcome` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1114-1174`) and records its `RuleSelectionFault` as an `error` run (`gate_check.rs:1089-1093`); the CLI rule view, its other caller, already selects from the report.
- The label-target checker evaluates graph rules over the scope slice (`evaluate_graph_scoped`, `gate_check.rs:536`); the issue checker keeps every configuration error of a rule matching the issue (`:469-472`).
- Built-in checker faults record `error` runs (`builtin_fault_run`, `:678`), while findings about repository content record `failed`. A missing or repeated target label, an empty namespace and an unresolvable or ambiguous target are faults today (`:659-673`), as is an unloadable rule set.
- Tests that re-prove filtering: `gate_check.rs:3186` (`test_repository_validation_warns_for_sorted_placeholder_gate_keys`, which calls `review_placeholder_findings`), `:3213,3238,3258,3282,3316` (label target), `:3347,3445,3508` (rule validation); `run_rules(None)` comparisons at `:2979,3415`. The fault classification is asserted at `:3531,3568`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the repository, issue, rule and label-target checkers computes one report over its image and converts the selection the contract assigns it; `repository_rule_report`, `captured_issue_rule_report`, `captured_scope_rule_report` and `rule_validation_outcome` no longer exist. The repository checker keeps its history-reading capture; the issue, rule and label-target checkers read no event-log history and no gate-run listing.
- [hard] REQ-02: One harness test shows, for one image and each checker kind, that the checker's findings equal the findings `jit validate` reports for the same selection.
- [hard] REQ-03: A run's status keeps the fault classification: an unloadable rule set, a `RuleSelectionFault`, and a missing, repeated, unresolvable or ambiguous target label record `error`; a content finding records `failed`.
- [hard] REQ-04: The listed checker tests are reduced to that wiring or removed where the selection tests own the property, and they no longer call the executor's placeholder pass or `run_rules`.

## Decisions

- **D-01** — Steward ruling 2026-11-04: REQ-01's "read no event-log history and no gate-run listing" concerns the report's inputs. The shared gate-evaluation capture that discovers the gate-run listing and event tail to publish the run (`capture_gate_evaluation_image`) is outside it and stays.

## Notes

- Behaviour changes: the label-target checker evaluates rules over the whole repository, so coverage children and dependency targets outside the target's subtree count; the issue checker's configuration errors narrow to the gated issue's subject or rule. With an unloadable rule set the issue checker keeps recording an `error` run, where `jit validate <id>` reports the `rules-file` finding.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Built-in validation gate checkers select from the report
